question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Convalesce
solution:
The correct answer is** Option 1)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"convalesce"** means to **recover one's health and strength over a period of time after an illness or operation.** (स्वस्थ होना)

 
 
• **Example:** After the surgery, he spent several weeks at home to **convalesce.**
 
 
 
• The word **"collapse"** means to suddenly fall down or give way. (गिरना)
 
 
• **Example:** Due to extreme exhaustion, he** collapsed** on the floor.
 
 

Therefore, the correct antonym is **'collapse.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Conceal** (छिपाना): To prevent something from being seen or known; hide.

 
 
• **Example:** He tried to **conceal** the truth from his parents.
 
 
 
• **Corrupt** (भ्रष्ट): Having or showing a willingness to act dishonestly in return for money or personal gain.
 
 
• **Example:** The **corrupt** official took bribes to approve the contracts.
 
 
 
• **Confront** (मुक़ाबला करना): To face up to and deal with a problem or difficult situation.
 
 
• **Example:** She decided to **confront** her fears by taking public speaking classes.
